name: Lila Cresch
source: Lila is [url=/c166785]Ryder[/url]'s childhood friend and roommate. They work together at [url=/c166788]Mary[/url]'s tavern, the Mutton Dagger. She longs to break away from her hometown and see the world. But is carefree and oblivious to the dangers that lurk in Threcia's borders.
